title: Development of selective nanomolar cyclic peptide ligands as GBA1 enzyme stabilisers
content:
RSC Chem. Biol., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4CB00218K, Paper
Open Access

Rebecca E. Katzy, Renier H. P. van Neer, Maria J. Ferraz, Kim Nicolai, Toby Passioura, Hiroaki Suga, Seino A. K. Jongkees, Marta Artola
Macrocyclic peptide ligands developed via RaPID technology selectively bind and stabilize rhGBA1 in plasma at nanomolar concentrations without inhibiting endogenous GBA1, offering potential for combinatorial ERT-pharmacological chaperone for Gaucher disease.
